note: Seat pools and recipes. A recipe's anchors must all be satisfied by the retiree; 'world' conditions by the Register.

elder.name: Elder of {city}
elder.text: The hearth answers to a name it knows.

warden.name: Warden of {landmark}
warden.text: One road keeps its law a while longer.

general.name: General of the Sun
general.text: The writs bear a second seal now.

high_priest.name: Voice of the Thousand
high_priest.text: The oracle speaks in a voice the squad knows.

master_of_moulds.name: Master of Moulds
master_of_moulds.text: The moulds are cut a little truer.

chronicler.name: Voice of the Chronicle
chronicler.text: The next Registers are told in this voice.

recipes.name: Warden of the Drowned Gate at {city}
recipes.text: A gate the tide will not pass while the warden stands.

recipes.name: Keeper of the Kings' Ford
recipes.text: The ford is held by someone who has held it twice.

recipes.name: Reader of the Road
recipes.text: The scribes send letters where this one has walked.

recipes.name: Bronze Elder of {city}
recipes.text: Remade, and still welcome at the hearth.

recipes.name: Speaker for the Tide
recipes.text: Someone the Sea has heard, and the Temple listens to.
